question: What additional preparatory rites may be performed before the main installation?
premises: An auspicious-day rite may be performed.
A site rite and fire offering may be performed.
Acceptance of the earth may also be performed.
inference: Preparatory rites may include puṇyāha, vāstu, homa, and acceptance of the earth.
plain_english: One may perform the auspicious-day rite, the site rite, the fire offering, and the acceptance of the earth.
